title: Seventh College General Education
source_note: UCSD catalog Seventh 章 + 学院 FAQ 页（2026-10-28 核对）；备选区课单按学期公布，只写规则 + 链接。

sections.title: Synthesis

requirements.name: Synthesis sequence
requirements.note: SYN 1 and SYN 2 (intensive university-level writing; R remote versions also offered) plus SYN 100 (project-based, requires junior or senior standing). Synthesis courses are exclusive to Seventh College and cannot overlap other requirements. Transfer students must complete SYN 100; SYN 150 (letter grade) is recommended preparation and fulfills the high-impact requirement.
requirements.note_zh: SYN 1、SYN 2（大学写作强化，另有 R 远程版）+ SYN 100（项目制，须高年级 standing）；综合课为 Seventh 专属，不得与其他要求重叠。转学生须修 SYN 100；建议先修 SYN 150（letter grade 可抵高影响要求）。

sections.note: SYN 1/2 + SYN 100; transfers must take SYN 100.

requirements.name: High-Impact
requirements.note: 1 course (2-4 units) from approved experiential learning options: internship, mentored research, study abroad, or other significant experiential learning (including SYN 150 taken for a letter grade, SYN 198/199 after SYN 100). May overlap major, minor, and university requirements. Transfer students must complete SYN 100 + high-impact; IGETC exempts the Alternatives areas.
requirements.note_zh: 高影响 1 门（2–4 学分）：实习、导师制研究、留学或其他重要体验学习（含 letter grade 的 SYN 150、SYN 100 之后的 SYN 198/199）；可重叠。转学生须完成 SYN 100 + 高影响；IGETC 免备选区。
